# Database migration fixtures

`skotiq-v4.3.0-profile.db` is a release-authentic schema-51 database used
to verify the 5.0.0 upgrade path to schema 55. It was generated by checking out
tag `v4.3.0`, opening `SkotiqDatabase` from that tag, and inserting a
representative equipment profile plus settings through the tagged schema.

The fixture is intentionally free of user data. Its provenance is pinned by
the `release_fixture_origin=v4.3.0` setting, SQLite `user_version=51`, and the
SHA-256 recorded by `production_migration_probe.dart`. The probe always copies
the fixture to a temporary directory before migration; the checked-in source
must remain unchanged.

To verify it for a release candidate:

```bash
cd packages/skotiq_core
SKOTIQ_OLD_DATABASE="$PWD/test/fixtures/skotiq-v4.3.0-profile.db" \
  flutter test tool/production_migration_probe.dart \
  --dart-define=REQUIRE_MIGRATION_ARTIFACT=true
```
